nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 storing token balances in StandardToken; mutated in transfer and transferFrom without SafeMath.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 storing allowances in StandardToken; mutated in approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Public uint256 total token supply of StandardToken, set in the ERC20Token constructor.
Public string token name, set to VISA in the constructor.
Public uint8 number of decimals, set to 10 in the constructor.
Public string token symbol, set to VISA in the constructor.
Public string version constant initialized to H1.0.
Caller-controlled address used for balance lookups, allowance authorization, minting in constructor and as the from argument of the low-level call.

Low-level _spender.call(bytes4(sha3('receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes)')), msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) executed before state finalization, allowing an attacker-controlled callee to re-enter.
Interface declaration of totalSupply() returning uint256 supply; no implementation.
Interface declaration of balanceOf(address) returning uint256 balance; no implementation.
Interface declaration of transfer(address,uint256) returning bool success; no implementation.
Interface declaration of transferFrom(address,address,uint256) returning bool success; no implementation.
Interface declaration of approve(address,uint256) returning bool success; no implementation.
Interface declaration of allowance(address,address) returning uint256 remaining; no implementation.
Transfers _value tokens from msg.sender to _to; performs unchecked balances[msg.sender] -= _value and balances[_to] += _value.
Transfers _value tokens from _from to _to using allowed[_from][msg.sender]; performs unchecked balance and allowance subtractions/additions.
Returns balances[_owner]; constant view of the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval; unrestricted allowance overwrite.
Returns allowed[_owner][_spender]; constant view of the allowed mapping.
Fallback function that throws on any plain ether transfer to the contract.
Constructor granting 10000000000000000 balances to msg.sender, setting totalSupply to 10000000000000000000, and setting name/decimals/symbol.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value, emits Approval, then performs an external low-level call to _spender.receiveApproval with attacker-supplied data.
Recipient address parameter of StandardToken.transfer.

Recipient address parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom.
Amount parameter of StandardToken.transferFrom used in unchecked arithmetic on balances and allowed.
Address parameter of StandardToken.balanceOf used to index balances.

Spender address parameter of StandardToken.allowance used to index allowed.
Spender address parameter that is both granted the allowance and targeted by the low-level call.

Arbitrary bytes parameter forwarded verbatim into the external low-level call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited account in StandardToken.transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender], making the allowance authorization caller-dependent.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], deriving the grantor from the untrusted caller.
Constructor mints the initial balance to the untrusted deployer address msg.sender.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] based on the untrusted caller.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument into the external low-level call payload.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value and balances[_to] += _value are unchecked arithmetic writes.
balances[_to] += _value and balances[_from] -= _value are unchecked arithmetic writes.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner] and returns it.
transferFrom requires allowed[_from][msg.sender] >= _value and decrements it, controlling authorization.
approve writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before performing the external call.
The constructor sets totalSupply to a fixed value.
The constructor sets the name state variable.
The constructor sets the decimals state variable.
The constructor sets the symbol state variable.
approveAndCall executes the low-level external call after updating allowances, exposing an external interaction point.
The low-level call can invoke receiveApproval on an attacker-controlled contract that re-enters approveAndCall or other token functions.
The _to parameter is the credited destination in StandardToken.transfer.
The _value parameter drives the unchecked subtraction and addition on balances.
The _from parameter is the debited source in StandardToken.transferFrom.
The _to parameter is the credited destination in StandardToken.transferFrom.
The _value parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic on balances and allowed.
The _owner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The _spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
The _value parameter is written into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
The _owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
The _spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
The _spender parameter is both granted the allowance and targeted by the external call.
The _value parameter is stored in allowed and forwarded to the external call.
The _extraData parameter is forwarded verbatim into the low-level external call payload.
